lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg12Si8Te4 (reduced formula Mg3(Si2Te)2) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Imma (No. 216), with 24 atoms per unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Mg centers in close-packed-like 12-neighbor environments, while Si adopts tetrahedral coordination with one Si and three Te neighbors; Te centers have 12 geometric neighbors (2 Mg, 4 Si, 6 Te). The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 24 sites, and validated polyhedron-sharing analysis identifies corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Mg-centered 12-vertex polyhedra and Si-centered tetrahedra.
